implementation_risks: Do not inherit qualified-only select_new_centers or NOT_APPLICABLE for an unqualified grid center: all nine complete neighborhoods are part of this declared diagnostic search.
Remove matched.points==design.points across different numeric centers. Compare common domains/protocol and actual center-specific designs, not falsely exact matched coordinates.

Use immutable reused_count and deepcopy rows; fixed unique global trial indexes and center-local point indexes. Each Optuna trial represents a center aggregate, not a child account score; child evaluation queues are a separate layer.

Keep original bound/result/ref bytes unchanged; use a separate authenticated center transport without the old point binding when creating the new ParameterEvaluationPlan. Public API rejects already bound inputs. Preserve explicit equivalence/provenance rather than rewriting old evidence.

Each new child’s parameter lineage points to its actual own numeric center, with correct public source/payload/dependency/input hashes; no old baseline plan identity pasted onto shifted neighborhoods.

Unqualified centers and children can be diagnostic accounts and are not registered or promoted. Publish complete successful and failed records; technical failures do not become economic negative scores.

strongest_counterevidence: Selected endpoint centers already fail return. Discrete holding/window coordinates, threshold crossings and position-state propagation make affine interpolation of parameters unrelated to affine interpolation of performance.

Three objectives can trade off: increasing joint pass count need not improve both absolute tails, and two tails can improve while every neighbor still fails a particular annual gate. Report each gate count and joint count; do not silently invent another hard goal.

The shared development market history and shared seed13 are used for selection and assessment. A winner can fit this finite parameter shell. Same-seed noise reduction is not an independent validation.

A 32-point tail uses only a few order statistics; overlapping neighborhoods and adjacent historical signal paths are strongly dependent. No independent probability or market generalization follows from 9x32 observations.
The finite two-line selection may miss other robust centers. Conversely repeated local searches increase total researcher trial count; record this new selection and all previous exposures.
No account-trade deletion, cash replay, or old profit attribution can substitute for the new complete native accounts.
